verdict.rationale: Plaid's product page claims a liveness check that confirms a person is present and that their face matches the ID image, which covers the core selfie-to-portrait match with liveness. The evidence is a single marketing-level statement, with no technical documentation of how liveness works or which spoofs it resists. Missing for 10: documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video; technical docs on the selfie/liveness check and its results; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, selfie checks match the live user to the document portrait with liveness detection — documented defenses against printed photos, screens, and replayed video

citations.quote: Ensure a person is present and their face matches the image on the provided ID.
